content: {"episode_id":"ep-05074","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring), which Cornerstone United determined was bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable. The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. The ordering documentation states the study was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation, establishing it as a distinct, medically necessary service rather than a bundled component. We therefore request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of $358.20 for episode ep-05074."}
